question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing left winger, Bob is playing right winger, Claire is playing striker, Dave is playing goalkeeper, Eve is playing center midfielder, Fred is playing sweeper, and Gertrude is playing left back.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Claire and Bob trade positions. Then, Fred and Eve trade positions. Then, Alice and Bob trade positions. Then, Eve and Fred trade positions. Then, Bob and Claire trade positions. Then, Eve and Gertrude trade positions. Finally, Gertrude and Eve trade positions. At the end of the match, Fred is playing
Options:
(A) left winger
(B) right winger
(C) striker
(D) goalkeeper
(E) center midfielder
(F) sweeper
(G) left back
solution:
Each row lists the positions of Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude, in that order.
Initial: left winger | right winger | striker | goalkeeper | center midfielder | sweeper | left back
1. Claire ↔ Bob: left winger | striker | right winger | goalkeeper | center midfielder | sweeper | left back
2. Fred ↔ Eve: left winger | striker | right winger | goalkeeper | sweeper | center midfielder | left back
3. Alice ↔ Bob: striker | left winger | right winger | goalkeeper | sweeper | center midfielder | left back
4. Eve ↔ Fred: striker | left winger | right winger | goalkeeper | center midfielder | sweeper | left back
5. Bob ↔ Claire: striker | right winger | left winger | goalkeeper | center midfielder | sweeper | left back
6. Eve ↔ Gertrude: striker | right winger | left winger | goalkeeper | left back | sweeper | center midfielder
7. Gertrude ↔ Eve: striker | right winger | left winger | goalkeeper | center midfielder | sweeper | left back
Fred's position, the sixth entry, is sweeper: option (F).
Final answer: (F)
